tools.name: craftboxx_get_company
tools.description: Get the company of the signed-in account (name, address, contact data). Craftboxx API: GET /my/company.

tools.name: craftboxx_list_employees
tools.description: List employees (name, email, phone, group, skills, inactive flag). Craftboxx API: GET /employees.

tools.name: craftboxx_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id. Craftboxx API: GET /employees/{id}.

tools.name: craftboxx_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (name, customer number, info). Craftboxx API: GET /customers.

tools.name: craftboxx_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. Craftboxx API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: craftboxx_list_projects
tools.description: List projects (title, project number, customer, sales volume). Craftboxx API: GET /projects.

tools.name: craftboxx_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id. Craftboxx API: GET /projects/{id}.

tools.name: craftboxx_list_assignments
tools.description: List assignments (planned jobs/appointments: title, project, start, end, state, planned time). Filter by date range or employee. Craftboxx API: GET /assignments.

tools.name: craftboxx_get_assignment
tools.description: Get one assignment by id. Craftboxx API: GET /assignments/{id}.

tools.name: craftboxx_list_timesheets
tools.description: List timesheets (employee, start, end, working time, break time). Craftboxx API: GET /timesheets.

tools.name: craftboxx_list_absences
tools.description: List absences such as holiday or sick leave (employee, type, start, end). Craftboxx API: GET /absences.

tools.name: craftboxx_list_absence_types
tools.description: List absence reasons (holiday, sick, ...). Craftboxx API: GET /absences/types.

tools.name: craftboxx_list_articles
tools.description: List articles in the material catalog (name, manufacturer, unit price, VAT rate). Craftboxx API: GET /articles.

tools.name: craftboxx_list_documentations
tools.description: List job documentations (reports written on assignments: title, state, type, author). Craftboxx API: GET /documentations.

tools.name: craftboxx_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer. Each call creates a new record (not idempotent). Craftboxx API: POST /customers.

tools.name: craftboxx_create_project
tools.description: WRITE: create a new project for an existing customer. Each call creates a new record (not idempotent). Craftboxx API: POST /projects.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: craftboxx_list_employees · Private data: craftboxx_get_company, craftboxx_create_customer, craftboxx_create_project · Public sink: craftboxx_list_employees, craftboxx_create_customer, craftboxx_create_project.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: craftboxx_list_employees · Private data: craftboxx_get_company, craftboxx_create_customer, craftboxx_create_project · Public sink: craftboxx_list_employees, craftboxx_create_customer, craftboxx_create_project

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
